name: Sam
source:
Bad-ass bartender who’s been to hell and back. Runs Icarus. Took a young Jude in when she was 17 and they have been family ever since. Don’t steal from her or she will stab you. No really. A lot of attitude and sass. Protective of her loved ones.

[From [url=https://jaimescribblesgames.com/2018/01/19/as-we-know-it/]Jaime Scribbles Games[/url]]
